description: This file defines a reStructuredText (reST) rendering widget for Kivy, including classes for document display, parsing, and rendering of reST markup, as well as custom node visitors for processing reST documents.

classes.name: RstVideoPlayer
classes.description: A subclass of VideoPlayer with potential for custom video rendering.

classes.name: RstDocument
classes.description: Main widget for rendering and interacting with reStructuredText documents, including parsing, navigation, and rendering logic.

classes.name: RstTitle
classes.description: Label widget for section titles in the reST document.

classes.name: RstParagraph
classes.description: Label widget for paragraph text in the reST document.

classes.name: RstTerm
classes.description: Layout for terms in definition lists.

classes.name: RstAsyncImage
classes.description: Async image widget for remote images.

classes.name: _ToctreeVisitor
classes.description: Visitor class for building table of contents trees.

classes.name: _Visitor
classes.description: Main visitor class for processing parsed reST documents into widgets.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Method to load and parse reST text into widgets.

methods.name: preload
methods.description: Preload a reST file to extract its toctree and title.

methods.name: resolve_path
methods.description: Resolve file paths relative to document root.

methods.name: on_source
methods.description: Handler for changes to the source filename.

methods.name: on_text
methods.description: Handler for changes to the reST text content.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Scroll to a specific reference within the document.

methods.name: set_text
methods.description: Set and format text for nodes.
